confidence_means: This is the game's published default layout. It is NOT proof of what this particular player has set in their own game options, and the agent must treat it as a strong hint rather than a fact about them.

kb_left_control.action: Slide while sprinting; horn in a vehicle

kb_f.action: Interact, enter or exit a vehicle

kb_left_alt.action: Draw or holster on a double tap, cycle weapons on a hold

mouse_left_button.action: Shoot, or a fast melee attack

kb_q.why: Two sources consulted on 2026-08-14 disagreed. Not resolved, so the agent must ask rather than pick.

kb_c.why: Widely reported as crouch but absent from the control list actually fetched, so it is unconfirmed and treated as unknown.

not_covered: Any control absent from both blocks above is unknown to this chart. Unknown is reported, never filled in.
